text: Dynamic morph allocation is no longer part of the open performance risk: exact topology reuse plus primitive coordinate/face access reduced the measured amplification from approximately 32x to 2.035x at 10,449 vertices and 2.000x at 163,842 vertices. mesh4s PointField primitive validation is repaired in local commit 13090e1ae8a5f4c440a4d29cb62a540ab885e402 with a 100k-point JVM allocation court and full JVM/JS/FullOpt provider gates green. The remaining tracked issue is strict topology ingestion/construction allocation, previously measured at approximately 149 MB and 1.884 GB at the two fixture scales; SurfaceWorldLink nearest-vertex acceleration also remains explicitly upstream/non-blocking.
